name: relay_off
summary: The 'off' relay state — the canonical no-relay passthrough; every other kind must mirror this layer set.

layers.fixHint: The relay_kind proto field uses a free-form string with the canonical kinds listed in a trailing comment. Add the new value to the comment so the Kotlin drift test sees it.
Define the new RelayKind* constant alongside the existing ones in RelaySettings.kt. Constant must equal the wire string.
Add a RelayKindDescriptor row to RelayKindDescriptors with kindId equal to the new constant. The RelayKindDescriptorDriftTest enforces a 1:1 mapping against the resolver registry.

Mirror the Kotlin descriptor row in RELAY_TRANSPORT_REGISTRATIONS with matching capability fields (tcp, udp, reusable, supports_outbound_bind_ip). The 'off' kind has no transport entry — it is the catch-all passthrough; any concrete relay kind needs a row.

checklist: core/data/model/src/main/proto/app_settings.proto — add the new kind string to the trailing comment of `string relay_kind = 171;`.
core/service/src/main/kotlin/com/poyka/ripdpi/services/RelayKindDescriptor.kt — add a RelayKindDescriptor row (kindId, capability bits, finalmask, config-backing).
core/service/src/main/kotlin/com/poyka/ripdpi/services/RelayKindResolverRegistry.kt — register a resolver in buildRelayKindRegistrations(); the drift test fails if a descriptor has no resolver.
core/engine-api/src/main/kotlin/com/poyka/ripdpi/core/RelayNativeConfig.kt — add any new fields to the wire DTO if the kind needs parameters.
native/rust/crates/ripdpi-relay-core/src/transport_descriptor.rs — add a RelayTransportRegistration row whose capability bits match the Kotlin descriptor exactly.
native/rust/crates/ripdpi-relay-core/src/backend/builder/builders/mod.rs — add a BackendBuilder if the relay runs in-process.
